name: Riftseeker’s Sanctum: Core
summary: The central nexus of Riftseeker power, where planar energies converge and Discord fractures pulse with unstable force.
description: The Sanctum Core is the heart of Riftseeker activity. Raw planar energy flows through crystalline conduits, forming rifts that open and close unpredictably. Riftseeker guardians maintain the delicate balance between elemental forces, while Discord anomalies threaten to destabilize the chamber. Muramite forces seek to breach the core to seize its power, but the Riftseekers defend it fiercely. The chamber is a swirling storm of arcane energy, planar instability, and ritual resonance.
